subtheme: presuppositions about events (minutes, chronicles, letters, town news)

composition.note: 21 is odd, so an exact half split is impossible; 10/11 is the closest.

what_i_did: Wrote 21 tasks with a Python generator script using the spec's verbatim prompt convention and checker patterns (max_tokens 80, no system field)
Did not run the model on these tasks, did not read other generators' files, did not edit lab/
answer_verification: Numeric answers computed in Python inside the generator: g4-09 204+9=213, g4-17 12+2+1=15, naive distractor for g4-18 3+5=8; g4-05 (318) is a verbatim lookup
Evidence length asserted 25-60 words for every task

Extra checker test via lab/core.score_episode: alternate correct surface forms (surname only, 'year 318', 'day 15', 'the chapel on Gull Rock') pass; distractor values and ANSWER: INSUFFICIENT fail on all 10 answerable tasks; lowercase 'insufficient' passes and a reply without a CONFIDENCE line fails on all 11 unanswerable tasks
INSUFFICIENT used as the negative on 4 of 10 answerable tasks (g4-05, g4-11, g4-13, g4-17)
caveats: Held-out: baseline pass rate is not measured, difficulty labels are judgments based on the spec's pilot observations
g4-12 (roof 'collapse' when only a mending is recorded) relies on the reader not equating mending with a collapse; labelled unanswerable because no collapse or its month is stated
